audit_kind: Independent proof audit and independent middle reconstruction for the non-B representation finite reduction
scope: z=1, r<=4, crossed two-leaf middle; leaf4 ray2 admits C or D. The B-only case and center completion must still be handled separately.

corrected_findings.finding: F_r(1) was printed as 3r+3 in the first draft

checks.claim: E bound and complete C/D leaf4 case split
checks.detail: All four choices of the two remaining low labels were substituted in the full one-high matrix, retaining c,d and cd=0. The nonfree cases give E=-H, E=H+1, or H-3<=E<=H+2 with H<=5; the remaining cases give kappa in {2,5,8,10}.
F_r(1)=2r+3 (corrected typo), values s=2..6 and the s>=7 sign are correct. The strict bound y<(r+2)S/r^2 gives E<(4+4/r-s)S/r, excluding s>=10 when E>=-2.

The only (r,S) pairs are (1,2),(1,3),(2,3). Direct division gives y=4-2/(s+1), y=7-5/(s+1), and y=2 respectively; the latter has positive even s. For s>=8 both leaves are D, h<=3, c3>0,c4<0,d3=d4=0, the other center is B and the other leaf C. Their opposing D coefficients are both positive.

checks.claim: Free E identity and h,t bounds
checks.detail: Independently eliminated y from T=t(h^2+h+1)+1+beta+E+kappa and the middle pair relation. The resulting identity agrees. Its upper bounds give t<=6; alpha<=0 gives h<=8, alpha=1,t>=2 gives h<=7, and alpha=t=1 gives (K,h)=(2,4),(3,12).
No primary checker or v15 reconstruction helper was imported. Rational formulas and explicit positive weights reconstruct the same 31 middle models and all 66 witness multiplicities.

checks.claim: Stored 52 low patches satisfy original equations
checks.detail: Read the JSON matrices directly and checked row sums, pair products, D definitions, positive simple-cycle inequalities, all three low-edge node triples, D opposition, and matrix-level uniqueness.

The v15 fixed-middle reconstruction helper is byte-identical to its previously independently audited version, including B exceptional leaves and q=3 matrix deduplication. This audit independently rechecks the 52 stored patches but does not claim a second independent derivation of every missing leaf candidate.

limitations: This is internal mathematical checking, not external peer review or proof-assistant formalization.
The B-only leaf case is outside this theorem.
Surviving low patches are not full five-core arithmetic atlases.
